title: The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.18933v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern coding agents are fundamentally reshaping the role of human input for computational research: they write code, launch in silico experiments, analyze their results, and autonomously operate with ever-increasing time horizons. Despite these developments, fully autonomous research agents suffer from a limited ideation radius and myopic hill-climbing search dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce The Agentic Scientist, an end-to-end distributed pipeline for human researchers to conduct computational research alongside modern coding agents. Building on its predecessor, our system decomposes research into task drafting, idea generation, planning, sandboxed experimentation, result aggregation, baseline and ablation construction, post-hoc analysis, and report writing. Importantly, each step in the pipeline is powered by the next generation of coding agents and leverages agentic self-verification. The overall research process is drive

translated_title: 智能体科学家：编排编程智能体以实现自动化科学（协同）发现
translated_abstract: 现代编程智能体正在从根本上重塑人类输入在计算研究中的角色：它们能够编写代码、启动计算机模拟实验、分析结果，并以不断延长的时间跨度自主运行。尽管有这些进展，完全自主的研究智能体仍存在构思半径有限、以及目光短浅的爬山式搜索动态等局限。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了“智能体科学家”，这是一个端到端的分布式流水线，使人类研究者能够与现代编程智能体协同开展计算研究。在其前作系统的基础上，我们的系统将研究过程分解为任务起草、想法生成、规划、沙盒化实验、结果汇总、基线与消融实验构建、事后分析以及报告撰写等环节。重要的是，流水线中的每一步都由下一代编程智能体驱动，并利用智能体自验证机制。整体研究过程由（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出了端到端分布式系统“智能体科学家”，将计算研究分解为多个阶段并由新一代编程智能体驱动、结合智能体自验证，实现人机协同的自动化科学发现。
en_tdlr: Introduces "The Agentic Scientist," an end-to-end distributed pipeline that decomposes computational research into stages—each powered by next-generation coding agents with agentic self-verification—enabling human-AI co-discovery in automated scientific research.
